common.notYet: Not active in this version yet.

launcher.tagline: A shared workspace for people and CLI agents.

language.body: Interface language. Can be changed in Settings.

appearance.body: The accent marks only what is active or selected.

profile.body: Team members and agents see this name.
profile.name: Display name

data.body: Workspaces, records and history are kept in this folder. Data stays on this computer; in a team it syncs only between members, over Tailscale.

agents.body: {{app}} runs the CLI agents installed on this computer. Sign-in happens in each CLI's own screen; {{app}} has no access to credentials.
agents.none: No agent is ready. Setup can be completed later in Settings.

team.body: Not needed for single use. Team members connect to each other with Tailscale; no server or account is involved.
team.solo: Single use needs no further setup.

agent.loginOpened: Sign-in opened in a separate window. The list is scanned again on return to {{app}}.
agent.googleNote: Google does not allow Gemini account sign-in to be used by third-party apps. This CLI runs only with GEMINI_API_KEY or Vertex.

hint.running: This computer is on the tailnet; other members reach it at its Tailscale address.
hint.stopped: The connection is made in the Tailscale app.
hint.needs-login: Sign-in happens in the Tailscale app.
hint.unknown: The Tailscale state could not be read.

shell.noSpecialists: No specialists. An agent for one kind of work is added here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Display name
settings.quietHint: During these hours advisors write only when called. Equal times mean no quiet hours.

update.disabled: Updates are off in development builds.

errors.not_installed: The CLI was not found on this computer.
errors.login_unavailable: The sign-in window could not be opened.
errors.core_offline: The core process is not responding.
errors.invalid_agent: Agent not saved: a field is missing or invalid.
errors.cli_missing: The CLI was not found on this computer.
errors.busy: The job is no longer running.
errors.provider_bad_url: Address refused: https is required; http only for this computer, the local network and Tailscale.
errors.provider_storage: Keys cannot be stored on this system.
errors.provider_no_key: No usable key for this provider.
errors.provider_rate_limited: The provider's rate limit is reached; it can be retried later.
errors.provider_unreachable: The provider could not be reached.
errors.provider_timeout: The provider did not answer in time.
errors.provider_bad_response: The provider's answer could not be read.
errors.invalid_advisor: Advisor details are missing or invalid.
errors.invalid_goal: Goal details are missing or invalid.
errors.goal_state: The goal is not in a state for this.
errors.not_git: The agent's folder is not a git repository.
errors.worktree_failed: The git worktree operation failed. There may be uncommitted changes.
errors.not_allowed: The role does not allow this.
errors.no_identity: The device key is not ready yet; it can be tried again shortly.
errors.no_address: Other members cannot reach this computer: Tailscale is not running or no address was found.
errors.bad_code: The invite code could not be read.
errors.already_member: This workspace is already joined, or a request is waiting.
errors.invite_refused: The invite was not accepted: the code may be used or expired.
errors.unreachable: The inviting computer could not be reached. Tailscale and the inviter's {{app}} must be running.
errors.no_folder: No folder chosen for this project on this computer.
errors.not_fabrika: The folder has none of Fabrika's ideas, references, .claude/commands or games.
errors.invalid_connector: The connector's details are missing or wrong.
errors.connector_storage: Secrets cannot be stored safely on this system.
errors.connector_failed: Could not connect to the connector.
errors.registry_unreachable: The MCP Registry could not be reached.

channel.newSessionHint: The agent leaves the earlier conversation in this channel behind.
channel.agentChannelHint: Every message in this channel goes to @{{handle}}.
channel.channelHint: Agents are called with @ in a message.

tool.untrusted_folder: Folder not trusted in Claude Code

error.cli_missing: The CLI was not found on this computer.
error.folder_missing: The agent's folder was not found.
error.auth_failed: The CLI sign-in is not valid. Sign in again under Settings → CLI agents.
error.app_closed: The job was cut off when the app closed.
error.driver_missing: This CLI cannot run jobs yet.
error.failed: The job ended with an error.
error.denied_by_owner: The agent's owner did not approve the job.
error.over_budget: The job's budget ran out; the job was stopped.

agentForm.name: Name
agentForm.folderHint: The agent works in this folder.

modeHint.read: Reads and searches files; changes nothing, runs no commands.
modeHint.edit: Edits files in the folder; commands that need approval are refused.
modeHint.full: Uses every tool without approval. Only in trusted folders.

agentForm.modelHint: Empty uses the CLI's default model.
agentForm.instructionsHint: Given to the agent with every job.
agentForm.noCli: No installed CLI can run jobs. Setup is under Settings → CLI agents.

hint.me: Other members see this agent but cannot give it jobs.
hint.members: Editors and admins can give it jobs; they run on this computer, on this computer's CLI login.

board.hint: Cards are dragged between columns. A card with an agent becomes a job with "Run as job"; when the job ends, the card moves to review.

commands.todo: Adds a task to the board
commands.newSession: The agent leaves the conversation in this channel
commands.council: Advisors discuss a topic in turn and one sums up
commands.goal: A goal for an agent: plan, approval, step by step
commands.remember: Adds a line to the personal notes
commands.status: CLIs, accounts and quota on every computer
commands.digest: An advisor sums up the channel's last 24 hours (/özet 6, /özet week, @advisor)

palette.placeholder: Channel, agent, project, view, action or message

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.stop: Stop the latest running job in the channel
shortcuts.needsModifier: Pressed together with Ctrl or Alt.
shortcuts.globalTaken: Another app uses these keys; the previous keys stay.

records.title: Title
records.refHint: Images are pasted, dropped or chosen. A reference attached to a message reaches the agent as an image.
records.select: A record is chosen on the left, or a new one is added.

instructions.coreHint: {{app}} enforces these rules in code; the text only explains them to the agent. Not editable.
instructions.workerHint: Added to every worker agent's system prompt.
instructions.workspaceHint: Given to every agent in this workspace.
instructions.defaultChanged: {{app}}'s default template changed after this text was edited.
instructions.previewHint: The whole system prompt the chosen agent receives.

providers.intro: Advisors, memory and voice run on these providers' models. Workers run on their own CLI logins.

protection.os: Keys stay on this computer, encrypted with the operating system's keychain, and are sent only to their own provider.
protection.weak: No keychain on this system: keys are encrypted with a fixed password, which is weak protection.
protection.none: Encryption is not available on this system, so keys cannot be stored. Local servers work without keys.

providers.name: Name
providers.baseUrlHint: https; http only for this computer, the local network and Tailscale.
providers.keyHint: Several keys are tried in order: after a 401, 403 or 429 the next key is used.
providers.deleteConfirm: Delete the provider and its keys?

connectors.intro: MCP servers that {{app}} itself connects to on this computer and serves, through its own endpoint, only to the agents allowed. Their settings and secrets never leave this computer.

protection.os: Secrets are encrypted with the operating system's key store and sent only to their own server.
protection.weak: This system has no key store: secrets are encrypted with a fixed password, which is weak protection.
protection.none: Encryption is not available on this system: no secret can be stored, only connectors without keys can be added.

connectors.name: Name

kindHint.remote: An MCP server with a Streamable HTTP address.
kindHint.local: A program {{app}} starts on this computer and talks to over stdio (npx, uvx, docker ...).

connectors.urlHint: https is required; http only for this computer, the local network and Tailscale.
connectors.urlBad: This address cannot be used: https is required (http only for this computer, the local network and Tailscale), and it cannot hold a user name or password.
connectors.commandHint: A program name or its full path. No shell is used.

secretsHint.remote: Sent with every request, for example Authorization = Bearer <key>. Stored values show only their last characters.
secretsHint.local: The program gets these; {{app}} never passes on key and token variables from its own environment.

connectors.agentsHint: Only this computer's agents. A job started by another member's request asks the owner at every call.
connectors.noAgents: This workspace has no agents of this computer.
connectors.deleteConfirm: Delete the connector and its secrets?
connectors.policyNote: New tools start without asking when the server says they only read, otherwise asking every time. A call that asks waits for approval on the job card; the agent never sees blocked tools.

catalog.title: {{app}} catalog
catalog.intro: Entries of the official MCP Registry that {{app}} checked; their install details ship with the app as they were on the day they were checked.
catalog.searchHint: A name or a job: github, docs, browser ...
catalog.communityNote: A community entry, not checked by {{app}}. Its source should be looked at before installing; local programs run on this computer as the app's user.
catalog.cannot: {{app}} cannot install this entry: it has no Streamable HTTP address and no npm, PyPI or Docker package (SSE, MCPB and OAuth are not supported yet).

missing.npx: npx is not on this computer: Node.js is needed (nodejs.org).
missing.uvx: uvx is not on this computer: uv is needed (docs.astral.sh/uv).
missing.docker: docker is not on this computer: Docker Desktop is needed.

advisorForm.intro: Advisors read the conversation and the project and give honest views. They write no code and start no jobs; a task they suggest lands on the board as a card.
advisorForm.noProvider: Advisors run on a model provider. A provider is added first under Settings → Providers.
advisorForm.name: Name
advisorForm.promptHint: How the advisor thinks. The presets can be changed here.
advisorForm.modelHint: Picked from the provider's list, or typed by name.
advisorForm.modelNoList: Model list not fetched; the model name is typed.

chatterHint.off: Writes only when called with @ and in /meclis.
chatterHint.low: Comments now and then on finished jobs and new ideas; drops in a few times a day.
chatterHint.normal: Comments often on finished jobs and new ideas; drops in every few hours.
chatterHint.high: Comments on most jobs and ideas; drops in at most once an hour.

advisorForm.channelsHint: Channels it speaks in unasked. None selected means all channels.
advisorForm.budgetHint: Daily token limit on this computer (input and output). When it runs out, the advisor is silent until the next day.
advisorForm.folderHint: Optional. Recent commits and git status are shown to the advisor, read only.
advisorForm.notesHint: Written here when the advisor ends an answer with a /not line, and given only to it in later turns. Stays on this computer; at most 2000 characters.

goal.title: Goal
goal.intro: The agent writes a plan first. Once the plan is approved it works step by step; after each step it reports and the done check runs. It stops when the goal is done, the budget runs out, or it is stopped.
goal.agentHint: Steps run at the agent's permission level.
goal.noAgent: A goal needs an agent first.
goal.checkHint: Optional. A command run in the agent's folder after each step; exit code 0 means the goal is done.
goal.planning: The agent is writing the plan.

pause.job_failed: A step failed or was stopped.
pause.agent_missing: The agent, channel or goal message is missing.
pause.no_plan: No plan found in the agent's answer; continuing asks for a plan again.
pause.interrupted: It was running when the app closed.

goal.worktreeHint: When the agent's folder is a git repository, the goal runs on its own branch in a separate git worktree; the main folder stays as it is and the agent can take other work meanwhile. Each step ends with a commit.

workspaces.intro: A separate workspace for a team: its own channels, agents, advisors, board and records. The personal workspace stays as it is; work in workspaces in the background goes on.
workspaces.name: Workspace name
workspaces.joinIntro: An invite code or link is pasted; which workspace it is for and whether the inviter's computer can be reached show at once. Once an admin approves the request, the workspace comes down to this computer.
workspaces.codeHint: Starts with SERAI1.; an invite link can be pasted too.

invite.title: Invite
invite.personal: The personal workspace is not shared. A new workspace is created for a team, and people are invited to it.
invite.intro: A one-time code that invites one person to {{name}}. Nobody joins until the request that comes with the code is approved.

roleHint.viewer: Reads and writes messages; cannot give jobs or change the board and records.
roleHint.editor: Gives agents jobs, adds own agents and advisors, edits the board and records.
roleHint.admin: Everything: channels, invites, roles and removing members.

invite.next: The request waits for approval here, in the members panel; nobody joins before it is approved.
invite.tailscale: The person's computer must reach this one over Tailscale: the same tailnet, or this device shared with them in Tailscale.
invite.message_one:
Invite to the {{name}} workspace ({{app}}).

1. Install and start Tailscale: https://tailscale.com/download
2. Install {{app}}.
3. In {{app}}, choose + → Join with a code and paste the code below. With {{app}} installed, the link does the same.

Code:
{{code}}

Link:
{{link}}

The code is valid for {{count}} hour and works once; the workspace opens when the request is approved.
invite.message_other:
Invite to the {{name}} workspace ({{app}}).

1. Install and start Tailscale: https://tailscale.com/download
2. Install {{app}}.
3. In {{app}}, choose + → Join with a code and paste the code below. With {{app}} installed, the link does the same.

Code:
{{code}}

Link:
{{link}}

The code is valid for {{count}} hours and works once; the workspace opens when the request is approved.

steps.tailscale: The person joining installs Tailscale and enters the same tailnet, or this device is shared with them.
steps.app: They install and open the app.
steps.code: They paste the code under + → Join with a code, or open the link.

phone.intro: {{app}} on this computer opens on paired phones too. Everything runs on this computer; the phone is only a screen. The connection goes over Tailscale.

problem.tailscale: Tailscale is not running, or this computer's name could not be read.
problem.https: Tailscale gives no HTTPS certificates on this network. They are turned on in the Tailscale admin console under DNS → HTTPS Certificates.
problem.serve: tailscale serve could not be run.
problem.port: The phone server's port (47620) is in use.

phone.scan: Scanned with the phone's camera, or the address is opened on the phone:
phone.install: On the phone, the browser's Add to Home Screen command installs it as an app.

unpaired.title: This phone is not paired
unpaired.how: In {{app}} on the computer, Settings → Phone → Add a phone shows the QR code to scan.

phone.pushOff: Notifications are off: jobs waiting for approval and messages do not reach the phone.

memory.topic: Agents and advisors know these in every job. Kept short and current.
memory.flagged: Something in this suggestion looks suspicious; it is read before it is accepted.
memory.personalHint: Stays on this computer and goes only to the agents on this computer.
memory.sharedTeam: Shared with every member of the workspace; editors change it.

hints.profile: Who the person is, what they do, how they like to work.
hints.notes: Personal things worth remembering. /hatırla adds here.
hints.conventions: Rules for code, names and ways of working.

project.name: Name
project.folderHint: The project's git clone. The folder stays on this computer; each member picks their own clone. Agents working inside it get the status page and the areas.
project.noFolder: No folder chosen on this computer.
project.notRepo: The folder is not a git repository.
project.leftOffPlaceholder: The project's current state, in a short paragraph.
project.areasHint: A record of who mostly works where. It blocks nobody: an agent may change any area it is asked to, and says so in its summary when the area is someone else's.
project.seedHint: A progress.md in the folder starts the status page.

handover.hint: A part of a person's request that the agent working on it gave to another agent. It runs as the same person's request and cannot be handed on.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.hint: Extra logins of the same CLI on this computer, for example a second account for when a subscription's quota runs out. Each account is the CLI's own config folder and is signed in with the CLI's own login; {{app}} does not read the login files.
accounts.name: Account name
accounts.agentHint: This agent's jobs run on the chosen login and its quota.

status.title: Status
status.teamHint: Other members' computers are added within a few seconds when they are on and connected.

fabrika.done: Imported: {{ideas}} ideas, {{references}} references, {{commands}} commands, {{projects}} projects; {{skipped}} were already here.

specialists.intro: A specialist is an agent that does one kind of work the same way every time: it follows its playbook, reads the channel before it starts, gets its fixed references, works within its budget and carries what it learned to the next job. A template is only a start; every field can be changed.
specialists.roleHint: One line: what it does. Members and other agents see it.
specialists.playbookPlaceholder: How it works, step by step.
specialists.playbookHint: Given with every job. English is recommended; the agent still answers in the person's language.
specialists.historyHint: How many of the channel's messages are read before a job. Search tools reach further back.
specialists.refsNone: No saved references. They are added under Records → References.
specialists.refsHint: The chosen references go into every job with their notes and images.
specialists.budgetHint: At three quarters of the budget the agent is told to wrap up; past it the job is stopped.
specialists.resultHint: The last line of the answer is one line of JSON; it is taken out of the chat and handed to whoever asked (a person or an agent).
specialists.connectors: Connectors that suit this template: {{names}}. They are installed under Settings → Connectors.

lessons.learnsHint: A lesson from a job its owner asked for is kept at once. One from another member's request, or one that looks like steering, waits here for approval.
lessons.keptHint: One lesson per line. Given to the agent with every job; when the limit is reached the oldest lines go.

reviewer.name: Code reviewer
reviewer.role: Reviews changes before they are merged and lists findings by severity
reviewer.about: Reads the diff and the calling code; finds bugs, risks and missing tests. Changes nothing.

tester.name: Test writer
tester.role: Writes tests that follow the project's own style and repairs broken ones
tester.about: Writes tests that pin behavior, runs them and reports what is covered.

researcher.name: Researcher
researcher.role: Finds things out with their sources; decides nothing and changes nothing
researcher.about: Looks in the records and code here first, then outside; gives a source for every claim.

modeler.name: 3D modeler
modeler.role: Makes 3D models in Blender that match the reference images
modeler.about: Studies the reference, builds, checks, renders a thumbnail and exports. Needs a Blender connector.

designer.name: Interface designer
designer.role: Builds and polishes interface to match reference images and the project's design language
designer.about: Uses the project's own colors, type and components; also builds empty, error and narrow states.

writer.name: Documentation writer
writer.role: Writes README, guides and release notes from the code as it is
writer.about: Reads the code and describes it as it is; changes only what is wrong or missing.

security.name: Security auditor
security.role: Looks for security problems in the project's own code and settings
security.about: Maps what is exposed, follows untrusted input, lists findings by severity.

custom.name: Blank specialist
custom.about: Starts without a template: the specialty and playbook are written from scratch.

share.copyHint: Copies the specialist's definition as text: its name, specialty, playbook and settings. The folder, references and lessons are left out.
share.pasteHint: The text someone copied with Share is pasted here.
share.bad: This text is not a shared specialist.

join.checking: Reading the invite and trying the connection.
join.bad: This text is not an invite code or link.

tailscale.ok: Tailscale is connected on this computer.
tailscale.stopped: Tailscale is off. It is connected from the Tailscale app.
tailscale.needs-login: Tailscale is signed out. Sign-in happens in the Tailscale app.
tailscale.unknown: Tailscale's state could not be read.

peer.online: The inviter's computer is in sight: {{name}}.
peer.offline: The inviter's computer ({{name}}) looks offline right now.
peer.unseen: The inviter's computer is not in sight on this network. Either both are in the same tailnet, or the inviter shares the device from Tailscale.

reach.ok: The app on the inviter's computer answers.
reach.off: The app on the inviter's computer could not be reached. It has to be running.

overview.projectsNone: No projects. A git repository is added as a project.

agent.title: A CLI agent is added
agent.hint: Claude Code or Codex installed on this computer becomes an agent working in a folder.

specialist.title: A specialist is added
specialist.hint: An agent for one kind of work: review, tests, research, 3D models.

project.title: A project is added
project.hint: A git repository: a status page, areas, pull and push.

advisor.title: An advisor is added
advisor.hint: A bot on an API key that reads the conversation and the project and gives its view.

team.title: A team workspace is created
team.hint: Others join with an invite code; the connection goes over Tailscale.

phone.title: A phone is paired
phone.hint: The same screen opens on the phone, and jobs waiting for approval arrive as notifications.

routines.topic: Messages posted at a set time, in their owner's name.
routines.intro: A routine is a message posted to a channel at a set time on set days, in its owner's name; an agent mentioned in it with @ takes the work. Examples: running the tests every morning, asking for the day's summary every evening. The message is posted on its owner's computer while the app runs there.
routines.textPlaceholder: @test run the tests and list what broke
routines.textHint: Posted to the channel as written. An agent or specialist is mentioned with @.
routines.everyDay: With no day chosen it runs every day.
routines.someDays: It runs only on the chosen days.
routines.messageHint: This message was posted by one of its owner's routines.
